column4: Visit note | 2025-02-05 11:00 AM | Dr. Mehedi Hasan, Ophthalmology | Patient: Rashid Karim, 38, male. Mr. Karim presents complaining of itchy, watery, and red eyes affecting both eyes, noting that his symptoms get worse in certain seasons. He works as a garment factory worker and mentions that the irritation began after visiting a farm in Gulshan. He reports no previous eye surgery or severe trauma. He has no comorbid medical conditions. He denies any sudden loss of vision or severe eye pain. On examination: visual acuity 6/6 in the left eye, BP 123/83 mmHg, pulse 69 bpm, weight 48 kg. The conjunctiva is injected bilaterally with mild papillary reaction. Assessment: Allergic conjunctivitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid rubbing the eyes, use cool compresses, and wear sunglasses outdoors. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-02-05 12:00 PM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Mitu Khatun, 28, female. Mrs. Khatun states that she has been suffering from loose watery stools and painful belly cramps. She works as a fisherman and explains that her illness started after eating biryani at a roadside shop in Chattogram. She has no chronic medical problems and denies any blood in her stool or persistent high fever. On examination: pulse 103 bpm, BP 133/79 mmHg, weight 85 kg. Her abdomen is soft with mild generalized tenderness, and bowel sounds are hyperactive. Assessment: Acute gastroenteritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to drink small sips of fluid often, eat bland foods like rice, bananas, and toast, and wash her hands before eating. Follow-up in 2 days if the stools do not settle.
